items.item_text: 01. Describe your experience which qualifies you for the position of Custodian. Include any custodial experience you have working for a school district or other public agency. (Limit your response to 300 words.)
02. Describe in detail the steps you would follow to strip and finish a resilient tile floor. (Limit your response to 300 words.)
03. Please list the chemical line with which you are most familiar. (Limit your response to 300 words.)
04. Describe the specific tools, machines, and equipment (type, brand, size) you have used in custodial positions, including swimming pool maintenance. (Limit your response to 300 words.)

05. This job involves multiple tasks that must be completed in specific time periods. Describe how you prioritize your work to get everything completed in a timely manner. (Limit your response to 300 words.)

06. Discuss your proficiency with computer programs. Include the programs with which you are familiar, your level of proficiency with those programs, and how you have used the programs in the workplace. (Limit your response to 300 words.)

07. Describe your experience working with or serving individuals from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and race/ethnic backgrounds and what you learned from the experience.?Give specific examples. (Limit your response to 300 words.)

Cleans campus spaces, pool and ground areas utilizing chemicals and materials that meet OSHA compliance standards (e.g. restrooms, classrooms, locker rooms, conference rooms, offices, receptacles, trash cans, etc.) for the purpose of maintaining a sanitary and safe environment.

Inspects campus facility for daily operation (e.g. building access doors, security system, restrooms, trash and garbage cans, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring the site is suitable for safe operations, maintained in a clean condition, and/or identifying necessary repairs due to vandalism, equipment breakage, weather conditions, etc.

Maintains supplies used to perform cleaning duties (e.g. chemical solutions, paper products, mops, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring the availability of items required to properly maintain facilities.
Performs minor maintenance (e.g. automatic scrubbers, buffers, vacuum cleaners, fixtures, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring equipment and/or facility components are in safe and working order.
Prepares campus facility for daily operations for the purpose of ensuring campus facilities are operational and ready for occupancy.

Responds to immediate safety and/or operational concerns (e.g. facility damage, alarms, emergency custodial calls, etc.) for the purpose of taking appropriate action to resolve immediate safety issues and maintain a safe, functioning educational environment.

Sets-up and takes down furniture, equipment, etc. for the purpose of ensuring that rooms are set-up in accordance with instructions for classroom activities, campus activities, special events, and meetings.
Transports equipment, supplies, and campus waste for the purpose of maintaining effective operation of facilities.

Performs other related duties as assigned (e.g. security building checks, responding to emergency requests, monitoring facilities during special events, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring the efficient and effective functioning of the campus.
Ability to prioritize work and multi-task.
